problem.title: How can I use different output templates for different log levels with Serilog when using appsettings for configuration?
problem.description: When using Serilog with .NET, I want to use a different output template for error level logs, since I want the error logs to contain additional information. I'm using the appsettings.json to configure how Serilog behaves, so I need a solution which uses JSON instead of C#. I am able to use "restrictiedToMinimumLevel" : "Error" to produce error logs with the additional information I want, but this results in the logs appearing twice (once with the extra information, and once without).
